high_level_description: The image shows a man sitting on a tiled bench outdoors. He is wearing a black t-shirt with white and orange accents, blue jeans, and black sneakers with neon green accents. He has a black hat with an orange band and is holding a yellow card or ticket in his hands. The man is also wearing sunglasses. In the background, there are several people standing and walking around. Some appear to be tourists, as suggested by their casual attire and the presence of a child being carried by one of the adults.
